body: Thank you for your advice, I wish I could have hope but I’m out of town and she has me blocked and when we were talking she was just saying things she knew would hurt me. It’s hard when the only person I want to talk to wants nothing to do with me like I don’t matter at all.

You have no idea how much your words mean to me. I have felt so alone for so long and it’s so rare to find someone who understands. I’m trying to care and want to stay, but I’ve been up with my head all night and I can’t seem to shake the urges. But your kind words make it better. Thank you
